title: gastrochilus roseus
intro: Gastrochilus roseus, commonly known as the Rose Dragon Orchid, is an endangered species of orchid native to the Himalayan region. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Gastrochilus roseus include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, making it a valuable treatment for respiratory infections and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
